name: Keyboard Layout Switcher
author: jesusarchive
description: Keyboard layout menu and switcher for the Omarchy bar. Ctrl+Space goes back to the last layout, Ctrl+Alt+Space steps to the next one.

barWidget.description: Shows the active keyboard layout as a badge. Click for the layouts menu, or bind Ctrl+Space for the last layout and Ctrl+Alt+Space for the next one.

schema.label: Show Input Source Name
schema.description: Show the keyboard layout name next to the badge in the bar.
